A global system is being built—one that will control who can buy or sell, based not on wealth or status, but on compliance. In this video, we expose how governments and global powers are using digital ID, CBDCs (Central Bank Digital Currencies), and surveillance tech to lay the foundation for what the Bible calls the Mark of the Beast.

This isn't science fiction—it's Bible prophecy. And it’s happening fast.

We break down how this system will be enforced, how personal freedom is being redefined, and why worship and loyalty are at the heart of it all. The technology is already here. The infrastructure is ready. Now the question is: Will you be ready to stand?
